scope: Focused review of Iran diplomacy, Venezuela’s talks, the Vitol records request and Alaska’s official results. Other tracked issues carry earlier conclusions or received a limited outcome check. The closing scan also verified Commerce’s Megaspeed rule and Treasury’s Iran designations.
summary: The November 23 estimates carry forward. The request for Vitol records puts Vice President JD Vance’s dealings with a political donor under scrutiny. Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio both retain access to Qatar, while President Trump decides whether to offer Iran new terms. Venezuela’s talks ended without an election date and Alaska posted official results. Army’s Iowa disposal, Huang and Teter House interviews and NATO surveillance aircraft deployment to Poland are pending. Lisa Cook litigation, pending confirmations, new Iran orders and broader voter and organizer reactions remain gaps. Commerce filed a rule naming Megaspeed and Treasury sanctioned Iran’s Currency and Gold Exchange Center. Iran’s claim of three tanker mine strikes remains unverified. European Commission proposes new Russia sanctions, with Council agreement pending.
